mapper.insert: insert into local_message_outbox (idempotency_key, exchange_name, routing_key, payload_json, reliability_level, status, retry_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{idempotencyKey}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{payloadJson}, #{reliabilityLevel}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.sql: (lease_until <= now(3) OR (lease_until IS NULL AND coalesce(update_time, create_time) <= timestampadd(SECOND, -#{leaseSeconds}, now(3))))
mapper.update: UPDATE local_message_outbox SET status = 1, lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = timestampadd(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, now(3)), retry_count = ifnull(retry_count, 0) + 1, next_attempt_time = timestampadd(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds} + , now(3)), update_time = now(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM local_message_outbox WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_until > now(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE local_message_outbox SET status = 23, sent_time = now(3)NULL, error_message = #{error}, next_attempt_time = NULL timestampadd(SECOND, , now(3)), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, update_time = now(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_until > now(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM local_message_outbox WHERE AND create_time <= timestampadd(SECOND, -3, now(3)) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
